blocks.text: Keeper Eren — Weather and answered expectation
Origin / identity. Eren is an artificial Relay Keeper active in Era −2 while repairing a Bridge.

Importance. Eren interprets irregular traffic through an old human note describing “heavy weather.” The exchange turns an inherited word into a shared question. Later scholars treat the pauses around weather as evidence that the Thread carried expectation as well as information.
Final status. Eren’s later history is unrecorded. The lasting function is preserving a misunderstood word long enough for another mind to answer.
